name: Art Nouveau

identity.oneLiner: Art Nouveau: flowing whiplash curves, botanical frames and organic ironwork.
identity.summary: Art Nouveau (c.1890–1914) unifies typography, botanical line work and architecture in composed organic forms. Botanical is Mucha/Grasset-inspired; Architectural interprets Guimard/Horta structural ironwork.
identity.authenticityNotes: Curves grow from structure; negative space protects content. No mass-repeated flowers, sticker art, or Deco geometry.

axes.shape: Organic arches, tapered whiplash lines, asymmetrical floral frames; readable controls retain practical geometry
axes.edge: Paired fine stems and selected vegetal corner arcs
axes.surface: Ivory/parchment and deep forest ink; calm contrast with muted pastel lithographic accents
axes.elevation: Almost flat; delicate ink edge and soft offset where needed
axes.ornament: Original six-vector grammar: vine, whiplash, floral spray, arch, iron stem, medallion, curved rule and corner
axes.typeVoice: Fraunces display with Jost body; architectural alternate Josefin Sans for signage
axes.motion: Measured organic transitions; no animated wallpaper or excessive drift
axes.density: Expansive ceremonial sections, disciplined forms and data
axes.iconography: Natural line shapes; functional labels remain standard

fonts.license: OFL-1.1 (all fonts already bundled in the repo)

bands.description: Elegant type, very fine organic rules, minimum display ornament; compact functional composition.
Recognizable flowing hero arch and one decorative stem; controlled botanical/architectural framing.
Full integrated whiplash, botanical spray or structural ironwork with flowing hero and sectional rhythm.

neverDo: Never repeat dense floral wallpaper across forms or product grids.
Never cover copy, prices or input controls with ornament or place ornaments in the pointer hit area.
Never mistake Art Deco gold steps, Groovy pop graphics, or Memphis scatter for organic Art Nouveau.
Never force organic clip paths on input controls; preserve contrast, focus and field labels.
No remote fonts/assets, licensed poster reproductions, runtime packages or ornamental JavaScript.

lines: era: art-nouveau; voice: botanical / architectural Belle Époque
identity: integrated whiplash, nature-inspired organic structure
type: Fraunces + Jost; architectural: Josefin Sans display
shape: sinuous arch, stem, spray, medallion; no geometric Deco steps
fidelity: whisper restrained | standard one flourish | costume full composition
use: organic luxury, museum, hospitality, botanical commerce
never: sticker flowers, ornament over controls, external resources
